outcome_detail: Ed Gallrein won the 2026 KY-04 Republican primary, defeating incumbent Rep. Thomas Massie 57,822 votes (54.9%) to 47,539 (45.1%) of 105,361 total, a margin of 10,280 votes / ~9.8 points. (Election-night snapshot at ~72% reporting showed a narrower 54.4-45.6, 8.8-pt gap; certified/near-final totals widened to ~9.8.)
source_label: Ballotpedia / NBC News / Kentucky Lantern (May 19, 2026 KY-04 GOP primary results)
reasoning: Final/certified totals: Gallrein 57,822 (54.88%) vs Massie 47,539 (45.12%), summing exactly to 105,361 two-candidate votes. Margin = 10,280 votes = 9.76 points. 9.76 >= 9, so the >=9-point bracket resolves YES. Multiple outlets (NBC, Kentucky Lantern, CNN, Washington Examiner) confirm Gallrein's win; raw counts cross-check to the cited 54.9/45.1 split. The only sub-9 figure (8.8) was a partial-count election-night snapshot, not the final result.
